name: mobile-repo-map
description: Point it at any Flutter or iOS repo and get an interactive map of how the app works: screens, navigation, API calls, architecture and risks.

scripts.demo: node bin/mobile-repo-map.js examples/flutter_shop --out docs/demo/flutter_shop --editor none --no-git -q && node bin/mobile-repo-map.js examples/swiftui_notes --out docs/demo/swiftui_notes --editor none --no-git -q
